title: cloth material shower curtain
text: cloth material shower curtain. I wanted a material, not plastic shower curtain and these are.  There is a stylish shear section about head level if you're on the taller side - it looks nice.  I wanted a simple white curtain and these do have a sort of waffle embossing to the material, and that is ok, but it might be busy in print if you're really looking for plain.  It came with plastic hooks that I recycled.  I made an additional purchase of stainless hooks with balls - as it is my opinion they pull the easiest and rust less.  Personal choice on that.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
